message: Vector Rebel 3.2.74: temporary swing firefighters in Daily Captain Check are required only for the tour/shift days selected with your crew; other shift/tour cells remain blank unless official PPE inspection history confirms a green check.
releaseNotes: A firefighter added through Daily Captain Check + Add Swing is only evaluated for the selected tour and specific Day 1 and/or Day 2 marked Here. The Daily Captain report does not retroactively assign PPE requirements for unrelated earlier shifts/tours, even if Scout confirms the person worked another apparatus. Those historical cells remain blank, not missed, OFF or unknown; previously completed native Vector PPE checks remain visible in green. The temporary swing row clearly labels the selected date(s). Original permanent Captain Set members continue to use Scout attendance across all units, and their off/deployment rules remain unchanged. The report and read-only Scout review now exclude a swing from historical attendance evaluations; only permanent Captain Set members are queried for those past tour comparisons. A previously saved 3.2.73 report with swings is recalculated automatically on opening from its locally preserved native Item Log/attendance snapshots, retaining its actual scan timestamp and evidence without another equipment scan. Recheck Missing is correspondingly limited to confirmed required checks. SCBA in-progress native inspection queues from all supported older versions remain compatible; no CrewSense or Vector inspection write is performed.
